$comment: Frontier step 0-ter: full draft claims, one entry per claim. In v2 the host submits five decision priorities (all if fewer) to a registered VP card, then gets their verdicts. Other leads remain unverified_memory, never silently dropped. verified still needs explicit VP reference and support; verification records an attempt, not successful support. removed is a legacy status, shown as an open marked lead in v2. Rules are in tools/check.py.

draft_sha256.description: SHA-256 of free_draft.md as it was when the claims were written.

quote.description: A passage of free_draft.md, word for word (spaces aside), that holds the claim or the reference.

ref.description: verified: {id, run, claim} of a VP run listed in intake.json vp.runs.

kind.description: Optional host classification. A lead can also contain a magnitude.

support.description: Verified claims: proposition, fragment, link, scope; checked against VP.

verification.description: Written by hybrid.py submit: exact VP card claim and host's decision-priority reason. Verdict read from that run, never typed here.
